title: Tesla Virtual Power Plant
summary: A QCon London 2020 talk by Tesla engineers on the architecture of Tesla's Virtual Power Plant. It covers aggregating distributed batteries and solar with vertically integrated hardware and software across cloud and edge.
why: Cited as a technical look at how Tesla's VPPs and Autobidder work as distributed systems.

quote.text: was an informative watch that covers the power problem space and their distributed software solution
